output.32: Re:Booth is an environmentally friendly exhibition booth that uses reusable materials, replacing conventional wooden booths that are often discarded after the exhibition ends. The main features are introduced below.
output.33: ・Use of reusable materials: A truss structure is adopted for the framework, allowing for a variety of designs such as hanging monitors. Reusable resin panels are used for the flooring.
output.34: ・Design flexibility and adaptability: By freely combining display panels and display stands, flexible layouts tailored to the scale and purpose of the exhibition are possible.
output.35: ・Cost reduction: Reusing materials eliminates disposal costs and offers excellent cost performance.
output.36: The following introduces the track record of Re:Booth to date.
output.37: ・Adoption track record: Re:Booth has been adopted at over 100 domestic exhibitions annually and has a track record of over 500 exhibitions overseas.
output.38: ・ROI improvement: High cost-effectiveness has been reported, with adopting companies achieving an ROI (Return on Investment) of 578%.
